messages:
Ari: Heads-up 10-min preflight for SolaceHealth renewal demo tomorrow. Drafting a tiny runbook focused on warmup, a quick tail probe, and the fallback script.

Ben: Please include a minimal warmup (6 calls) and a one-liner probe we can run live.

Cleo: Runbook to paste into the invite:
1) Goal (30s) - confirm uptime + acceptable phrasing variance.
2) Warmup (3m) - 6 exact demo prompts to prime KV cache.
3) Tail probe (2m) - run probe and share p50/p95/p99 + kv-hit%.
4) Failover demo (3m) - toggle to faster fallback, explain tradeoffs.
5) Capture actions (1.5m).

Ben: Probe one-liner:
`python tools/latency_probe.py --tenant solace --model open-7b --n 20`
Outputs p50/p95/p99 and kv-cache-hit%.

Ari: Customer note to paste: "If latency rises, we'll switch to a faster model to keep replies available; this may slightly change phrasing. We'll log differences and follow up."

infra-bot: [deploy] Solace canary: last deploy 2026-03-12T07:00:00Z. No incidents.

Cleo: Action owners: Ben - attach probe output and token estimate; Ari - paste runbook + customer note to invite. Ready for tomorrow. :thumbsup:
